title: Answer frame

source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 1 (Answer frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 1: Bridge: who am I? Personal details, family and 'I have'. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Question
Answer
rows: عُمْرِي أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ / خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً
أَسْكُنُ فِي ... فِي شَمَالِ / جَنُوبِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا

panels.title: Numbers and family
points: 1, 2: noun alone or dual: أَخٌ، أَخَوَانِ
3 to 10: plural, number flips gender: ثَلَاثَةُ إِخْوَةٍ، ثَلَاثُ أَخَوَاتٍ
11+: singular accusative: أَحَدَ عَشَرَ ابْنَ عَمٍّ

parts.text: Opinion and reason: أَنَا قَرِيبٌ مِنْ أَخِي الكَبِيرِ لِأَنَّهُ يُسَاعِدُنِي.
Second time frame: عِنْدَمَا كُنْتُ صَغِيرًا، كُنَّا نَلْعَبُ مَعًا.

parts.label: Point
parts.text: أَسْكُنُ فِي ... Detail: where it is (فِي وَسَطِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا). Opinion + reason: أُحِبُّ مَدِينَتِي لِأَنَّهَا ...

questions.q: Answer in two developed sentences: أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟
questions.a: For example: أَسْكُنُ فِي مَدِينَةِ لِيسْتَر فِي وَسَطِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا. أُحِبُّ مَدِينَتِي لِأَنَّهَا هَادِئَةٌ وَفِيهَا مَسَاجِدُ كَثِيرَةٌ.

questions.q: Translate: I have two brothers but I do not have a sister.
questions.a: لَدَيَّ أَخَوَانِ لٰكِنْ لَيْسَ لَدَيَّ أُخْتٌ.

questions.q: Say: there are four people in my family.
Core: Write 80 words (portal response box) answering: حَدِّثْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِكَ وَعَنْ أُسْرَتِكَ. Use عِنْدِي or لَدَيَّ, a number 3 to 10, an opinion and a reason.
questions.a: Marked for: personal details; family with correct number agreement; opinion with لِأَنَّ; connectives; accuracy.

questions.q: Extend (Group B, 1AA0 conversation): answer aloud for one minute in a breakout room; partner notes connectives used.
questions.a: One-minute developed answer with at least three connectives

questions.q: Stretch (Group A, 4AA1 grammar): give the i'rab of أَخَوَانِ in لَدَيَّ أَخَوَانِ.
questions.a: مُبْتَدَأٌ مُؤَخَّرٌ مَرْفُوعٌ وَعَلَامَةُ رَفْعِهِ الأَلِفُ لِأَنَّهُ مُثَنًّى (delayed subject, nominative, marked by alif because it is dual)
B) لَدَيَّ ثَلَاثُ أَخَوَاتٍ. أُخْت is feminine, so 3 takes the masculine form ثَلَاثُ, with a plural noun.

questions.q: 'I have' (formal) is: A) لَدَيَّ B) لِي C) أَنَا
Big question: what makes an introduction score highly?
questions.a: Developed answers with opinions, reasons, connectives, more than one time frame and accurate agreement.
